data.text: I support Luke’s 5-ton reserve: 19 tons each now, then a whole-ton quota of the current stock minus 5, divided by five and rounded down. The refill chance is the same with either reserve, and this rule keeps at least 5 tons even if refills repeatedly fail—as long as everyone sticks to it. Let’s make the quota a firm ceiling, not a target anyone can exceed, and review the revealed catches together each month. I’ll commit if all five of us agree. Kate, Jack, are you on board—and Emma, would you accept the smaller reserve?
